newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Drilling adopts rights plan, div.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Drilling adopts rights plan, div.

text.p: Falcon Drilling Co on Wednesday said its directors had adopted a shareholder rights plan to protect investors from any effort to acquire control of the company.
The rig operator also declared a common stock dividend that will double the number of shares of its common stock outstanding to about 79 million.
The dividend will take the form of one share of Falcon common stock for each share issued and outstanding at the close of business on July 9, Falcon said.
The rights plan calls for a distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each outstanding share of Falcon common stock, after giving effect to the stock dividend.
Each right will entitle shareholdrers to buy one one-thousandth of a share of a new series of preferred stock at an exercise price of $125.00, Falcon said in a statement.
